pay_detail: Not stated. We read the city news post and the boards page on 2026-10-10. Neither says anything about pay. Ask the city.
name: Mayor's Chief of Staff Internship (KidsMatter)
what_you_do: Support the mayor at community events. You greet people, answer questions and take photos. Hours follow the event schedule, with some evenings and weekends.
who_can_apply: Up to 8 sophomores and juniors who live in Naperville. You must live inside the city limits. Freshmen and seniors cannot apply. Students who served on a board or commission cannot apply.
deadline_text: 2026-27 applications were due 5 p.m. Friday, Sept. 4, 2026. Selected students start at the KidsMatter Leadership Academy on Saturday, Nov. 7 (this fall). The city post is dated August 10, 2026. Next year's call is not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply button on any board or commission page of the city site. Answer yes to the Mayor's Chief of Staff question. Upload a resume or a note about your interest. Say that you are free all year.
notes: The news post does not say whether it is paid. Ask Rachel Pruneda (prunedar@naperville.il.us, 630-420-6018). A full job description is on the city boards page.
